Gestalten Sie mit uns die Industrie von morgen – als Projektleiter/in im im Bereich mechatronische Systeme

Seit fast 15 Jahren begleiten wir als Beratungs-, Projekt- und Entwicklungspartner namhafte Industrieunternehmen in dynamischen Veränderungsprozessen. Unsere Kunden schätzen uns als vielseitige und pragmatische Experten in den Bereichen Engineering, Konzeption und Entwicklung.

Unser interdisziplinäres Team besteht ausschließlich aus erfahrenen Fachkräften mit fundierter und langjähriger Expertise. Gestaltungskraft, Innovationsfreude und Umsetzungsstärke treiben uns an – für nachhaltige Lösungen und messbaren Kundennutzen.

Mit Standorten in Oberhaching, München, Hamburg und Toulouse sind wir geografisch wie inhaltlich nah an unseren Kunden und Projekten.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir engagierte Projektleiter/innen im Bereich mechatronische Systeme, für Projekteinsätze in Deutschland, Österreich, Frankreich, der Schweiz und Italien.

Aufgaben

Kernaufgaben:

1. Projektplanung

  • Ziele und Anforderungen definieren
  • Projektstrukturplan erstellen
  • Zeit-, Kosten- und Ressourcenplanung
  • Meilensteine und Termine festlegen
  • Risikomanagement planen
  • FMEA begleiten

2. Teamführung und Koordination

  • Projektteam zusammenstellen
  • Aufgaben verteilen und koordinieren
  • Motivation und Führung des Teams
  • Schnittstelle zwischen verschiedenen Abteilungen managen
  • Lieferanten managen

3. Kommunikation

  • Regelmäßige Projektmeetings (intern und extern)
  • Ansprechpartner für Stakeholder und Auftraggeber
  • Projektstatus berichten (z. B. in Form von Statusberichten oder Präsentationen)
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Einkauf, Fachabteilung, managment und Qualität

4. Projektüberwachung & -steuerung

  • Fortschritt überwachen (Zeit, Kosten, Qualität)
  • Abweichungen erkennen und gegensteuern
  • Änderungsmanagement (Change Requests)
  • Qualitätssicherung
  • Mitarbeit im Steering Boards

5. Projektabschluss

  • Projektergebnisse abnehmen lassen
  • Dokumentation und Lessons Learned
  • Teamauflösung und Nachbereitung
  • Präsentation auf C-Level
  • Steuernde Tätigkeit vor Ort am Projektstandort (Bereitschaft zu Dienstreisen)

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen, Physik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Projektmanagement, idealerweise in den geforderten Bereichen
  • Umfangreiche Projektmanagement Methodenkompetenz
  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten in der Teamführung und exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Projektmanagement-Tools und -Methoden
  • Staatsbürger eines EU-Landes
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. C1-level)
  • PKW Führerschein

Benefits

  • Festes Arbeitsverhältnis
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Ein vielseitiges Aufgabenfeld mit hoher Eigenverantwortung
  • Stabiles Unternehmen mit flachen Hierarchien
  • Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Spannende Kundenprojekte
  • Hervorragen Arbeitsplatzausstattung

Why this is your place This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. Lead functions where the results show up directly in the experience of 6.5M+ people and the businesses they pay every day. Operate in high-growth. About Munich Electrification

Munich Electrification is an innovative company founded with the aim of accelerating the transition to electric and connected mobility. We develop innovative electronic control units for electric vehicles and stationary storage systems for our global customers. Our international team is composed of highly motivated and exceptional engineers. As a small and specialized team we are well-aware of the importance of each individual colleague and support and promote each employee according to their abilities and needs. Our office with adjacent prototype and testing lab is located in the heart of Munich at the Heimeranplatz.

This is what we stand for:

- Technological Leadership: We challenge norms, innovate quickly, and anticipate future needs. We take smart risks and learn from outcomes to stay ahead.

- Sustainability: We actively drive change for a sustainable future, aware of our impact and inspiring others to build a better world.

- Team Culture: We believe work should be enjoyable, fostering a spirit of inspiration, celebration, and teamwork across the globe.

- Entrepreneurial Spirit: We embrace change, think big, and push limits with passion.

About the Role

As the Head of Program Management, you will own the execution of our project portfolio from first concept to series production across Automotive, Commercial Vehicle, and Industrial BESS. That means leading teams of Project Leads, Product Owners, and Field Application Engineers, and reporting directly to the Chief Customer Officer. You are an entrepreneurial leader who thrives on turning complex development roadmaps into tangible, high-quality products while balancing the unique demands of both vehicle-level and grid-scale energy storage safety and performance.

Your Future Tasks at a glance

  • Operational Excellence: Oversee the end-to-end execution of all projects, ensuring they meet milestones, budget constraints, and resource allocations. Identify cross-project synergies and manage dependencies to mitigate systemic risks.

  • Team Mentorship: Lead Team Leads and senior contributors to foster professional and technical growth.

  • Strategic Staffing: Optimize organizational structure and resource allocation across programs to balance capacity, driving throughput and profitability.

  • Department Alignment: Act as the primary interface for C-level management, aligning departmental goals with the overall company strategy and reporting on KPIs.

  • Governance & Process Design: Define and continuously optimize department processes and interfaces to other departments (Engineering, Operations, Sales, and Quality).

  • Conflict & Escalation Management: Serve as the ultimate internal escalation point for critical project roadblocks, and make the call.

  • Commercial & Technical Stewardship: Ensure that both commercial governance (contracts, deliveries) and technical maturity (e.g. V-cycle, ASPICE) stay on track across all programs.

Who you are and what you have

  • Experience: 8+ years of leadership in Program or Project Management, specifically in automotive, battery, or power electronics. You have successfully led a "team of teams."

  • Education: A university degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field that combines technical understanding with commercial acumen.

  • The "Advocacy" Trait: You are comfortable pushing back. When cross-functional goals conflict, you can mediate and make firm decisions, acting as a buffer for your team rather than just escalating or deferring.

  • Leadership Skills: Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams (interacting with HW, SW, Systems, Operations) and manage leaders (Team Leads).

  • Communication: Exceptional presentation and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust with international Tier-1 or OEM customers and navigate C-level stakeholders.

What We Offer

  • Impact: A key leadership role (~30 direct or indirect reports) with the autonomy to shape the future of our program management organization.

  • Culture: A flat hierarchy that values direct, honest communication and fast decision-making over process for process’s sake.

  • Growth: Be at the forefront of the green energy transition, in a high-tech, international, fast-growing company.

  • Flexibility: Modern working conditions with a focus on results.

Our Offer & Benefits

The chance to be part of a highly innovative, agile, and unique team with prestigious customers in the automotive and battery storage sector. You will gain a deeper knowledge around connected & electric vehicle batteries, battery management and electronics development and strive in an exciting work environment

Benefits (Full-time Employees):

- Trust-based working hours and hybrid work

- Adequate and competitive compensation

- Pension Plan/Bonus

- Free access to the fitness center right next to us or subsidized EGYM Wellpass

- Free snacks, coffee, drinks and lunch (freshly cooked by our chef) every day

- Public transport ticket

- Bike-Leasing via Business Bike

- Experience various inspiring and fun team events

- ME-branded clothing

- Option to "work from anywhere" (6 weeks/year)

cards.announcement: As a Working Student or Intern (m/f/d) in the field of Land Systems / UGV Industrialization, you will support our team in Göppingen in establishing serial production for unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs). You will work closely with the Industrialization team and our external consulting partners, taking responsibility for clearly defined work packages in documentation, data management, and production planning preparation. You will collaborate across Production, Engineering, Quality, and Logistics, gaining first-hand experience of a real production ramp-up from the very beginning and seeing how a prototype-based setup evolves into a scalable and repeatable serial production process. What is your Day to Day Mission: Support the shopfloor planning activities at our Göppingen site by documenting current-state processes and contributing to layout planning, material flow design, and production cycle data (e.g., cycle times, workstation utilization, and walking distances). Support process design activities by helping to structure and document assembly processes for different vehicle variants down to individual work-step level. Create and maintain illustrated work instructions for production processes. Collect, prepare, and analyze process-related data using Excel. Support qualification and training activities by maintaining workstation-specific skill matrices and preparing training materials for assembly teams. Prepare and follow up on workshops and alignment meetings with external consulting partners, including meeting minutes, task tracking, and status reporting. What you bring to the team: You are currently pursuing a degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Logistics, or a comparable field of study. You are proficient in using Excel and PowerPoint; initial experience with CAD or layout planning tools is a plus. First practical experience in manufacturing, workshop environments, or through academic projects is welcome, but not required. You work accurately and reliably when creating documentation and maintaining data, including recurring tasks. You have a structured and independent way of working and are willing to take ownership of your tasks and follow up on topics proactively. You communicate openly and professionally and enjoy collaborating with colleagues from Production, Engineering, and external partners. You are available to work regularly on-site in Göppingen; the scope and duration of your engagement can be tailored individually. You have good German and English language skills. You have experience using AI tools effectively. You are available to start immediately or by November 1st at the latest. Wir überschreiten Grenzen, blicken über den Tellerrand und streben nach technologischer Exzellenz, um die Zukunft unbemannter Systeme mitzugestalten. Wir versprechen, dass wir Deine Startbahn für individuelles und berufliches Wachstum sein werden. Our benefits: Flexible working hours: With our trust-based working time model, you have the flexibility to manage not only your working hours but also your work-life balance independently. Corporate Benefits: Take advantage of attractive offers and discounts from well-known brands and providers such as Adidas, Apple, and Expedia. Team Events: We believe in growing together and celebrating our successes as a team. About us: Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe. What you'll own as our Senior AI Product Designer You'll own end-to-end design for one of our core product areas, on a platform where AI is the foundation of the product, not a bolt-on feature. Your mission is to bring consumer-grade craft to a B2B healthcare product used by clinicians and hospital administrators under real time pressure, and to help invent the design patterns for AI-native surfaces that don't exist anywhere else yet. You design the AI-native surfaces our platform is built around, including multi-modal interfaces, agent state, uncertainty, and human-in-the-loop controls, inventing the patterns as you go rather than adapting existing ones. You own end-to-end design for a product area – Discharge Core, Voice Desktop, Extract & Docs, Patient Overview, or Agent – taking work from a messy problem statement through to what ships in production. You contribute to our design system, building the components and AI-specific conventions that other designers and teams build on. You partner closely with product and engineering, shaping technical and product direction rather than being handed a spec to execute against. You work with other designers across the organisation, bringing your input and influence beyond your own product area rather than staying inside a single team's boundary. You hold a high craft bar in critique, lifting the standard of what the wider design team ships. You help hold coherence across our AI Suite (Voice, Docs, Extract, Agent) and Discharge Core, so a fast-growing multi-product platform still feels like one product to the people using it. Consumer-grade craft is the bar, even in B2B. Our users are clinicians and hospital administrators. Human-in-the-loop by default. You have taken features from 0 to 1 through an ambiguous problem statement to shipped code, and you're comfortable feeling like a PM or frontend developer on the days that calls for it. You have high agency and spot gaps without being asked to look for them, including outside your own product area. You hold a position under pressure but change it when new information warrants, rather than becoming precious about your own decisions. cards.announcement: Role Als Medical Director verantwortest du den medizinischen Themenkatalog einer der größten CME-Lernplattformen Deutschlands. Was wir zeigen, erreicht unzählige Ärzt:innen – deine inhaltlichen Entscheidungen haben unmittelbaren Einfluss darauf, welches medizinische Wissen in Deutschland ankommt. Du führst unser siebenköpfiges Medical Team, hältst den Kontakt zu Chefärzt:innen und Meinungsbildner:innen, entwickelst neue Fortbildungsformate mit und baust die Prozesse, mit denen wir vom Startup zum Scale-up werden. Die Rolle ist bewusst breit: strategisch in der Katalog- und Formatentwicklung, operativ im Tagesgeschäft, und immer mit der ärztlichen Perspektive als Maßstab. Your tasks Verantwortung für den Themenkatalog: Du steuerst, welche medizinischen Themen wir abdecken – fachübergreifend, evidenzbasiert und mit einem klaren Blick für Versorgungsrelevanz und Lücken im Markt. Referenten-Netzwerk: Du bist tagtäglich im Austausch mit Chefärzt:innen und KOLs, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und gewinnst daraus kontinuierlich neue Fortbildungsideen. Team-Leadership: Du führst und entwickelst unser Medical Team – zwei Vollzeitkolleg:innen und fünf Studierende. Die Medical Editors arbeiten inhaltlich und stimmen Projekte mit Sponsoren und Referent:innen ab; die Medical Students übernehmen Quality Control, erstellen Kursbeschreibungen und entwickeln neue Themenideen. Formatentwicklung: Wir produzieren Videos, Panel-Diskussionen und E-Learnings – Form und Inhalt greifen ineinander. Bei neuen Formaten wie Kurzvideos oder der Gamification des Lernerlebnisses ist dein medizinischer Input und die ärztliche Perspektive der entscheidende Faktor. Projekt- und Themensteuerung: Du managst die Themenideen laufender Projekte und stimmst dich eng mit Referent:innen ab, damit Projektanforderungen inhaltlich sauber umgesetzt werden. Qualitätssicherung & Compliance: Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Fortbildungen den CME-Standards entsprechen, evidenzbasiert sind und die regulatorischen Anforderungen erfüllen. Prozessverbesserung & Automatisierung: Auf unserem Weg zum Scale-up stehen Automatisierung und schlanke Prozesse im Mittelpunkt. Du streamlinest Workflows und Dokumentationstools im Team und teamübergreifend – als Director bist du dabei die Schlüsselrolle für funktionierende Cross-Department-Zusammenarbeit. Your profile Hintergrund: Abgeschlossenes Studium der Medizin. Berufserfahrung: Idealerweise 5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung, gern klinisch, in der Industrie oder in der digitalen Gesundheitsbranche. Führungserfahrung: Erste Erfahrung als Team Lead ist ein klarer Vorteil – entscheidend ist, dass du Menschen entwickeln und Prioritäten setzen kannst. Anpack-Mindset: Wir skalieren. Du regelst Dinge selbst, statt sie nur zu delegieren, und scheust dich nicht davor, auch operativ mit reinzugehen. Begeisterung für Prozesse: Du hast Freude an Projektmanagement, Strukturaufbau und medizinischem Content bzw. medizinischer Lehre – diese Kombination ist der Kern der Rolle. Von Vorteil: Erfahrung in einem Startup sowie in der medizinischen Lehre. Kommunikationsstärke: Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber führenden Mediziner:innen und Industriepartnern, professioneller Kommunikationsstil mündlich und schriftlich. Sprachen: Deutsch auf Muttersprachenniveau und fließendes Englisch sind Voraussetzung. Why us? Echter Impact: Die Themen, die du verantwortest, erreichen über zig tausende Ärzt:innen. Durch die Verbreitung des neuesten medizinischen Wissens hast du direkten Einfluss auf die Versorgungsqualität in Deutschland. Mitgestaltung: Du prägst neue Fortbildungsformate und den medizinischen Qualitätsanspruch der Plattform von Grund auf mit. Wachstum & Perspektive: Wir wachsen schnell – entsprechend gibt es echte Aufstiegs- und Gestaltungschancen, die mit dem Unternehmen mitwachsen. Ownership: Kurze Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien und die Freiheit, eigene Ideen umzusetzen. Team: Ein junges, motiviertes und wirklich gutes Team in Prenzlauer Berg. Teamevents, Ausflüge sowie Bier und Wein im Kühlschrank gehören dazu. Benefits: Attraktives Gehaltspaket inkl. Aktienpaket (VSOP) sowie ein Urban Sports Club Abo. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

cards.announcement: Your mission Breakthrough technologies can create entirely new industries and companies of global relevance – but only if scientific excellence is matched by exceptional execution, capital and commercial ambition. As Director Venture Scaling iF Momentum, your mission is to help build the next generation of DeepTech champions: companies with the potential to become category leaders, scale internationally and transform their industries. You will work side by side with exceptional founders, opening access to industry, capital and talent while developing iF Momentum into a leading European platform for scaling ambitious DeepTech ventures. Take ownership of iF Momentum and its portfolio of highly ambitious DeepTech ventures, helping founders build companies with the potential to become global category leaders while ensuring outstanding program quality, team performance, budget discipline and measurable impact. Identify venture-scale opportunities and challenge founders on the fundamental choices that determine scale: market ambition, positioning, value propositions, business models and commercial strategies and the path towards building a globally competitive company. Turn technological advantage into commercial momentum by helping ventures move from first market validation towards repeatable customer demand, scalable go-to-market models and international growth. Drive commercial and industry scale-up by helping startups develop customer use cases, industrial pilots, venture-client collaborations, licensing models and strategic partnerships – and turn early validation into repeatable commercial traction. Build the financing pathway required for scale – from the next institutional funding round to the capital required for industrialisation and international growth – by challenging financial models, cap tables, equity stories, funding strategies, investor materials and data rooms. Establish clear milestones and priorities for each venture, continuously challenge whether they are on the fastest credible path towards commercial scale, and deploy program resources where they can create the greatest enterprise value and impact. Lead and develop a multidisciplinary venture-building team and coordinate closely with colleagues across the wider Impossible Founders platform. Build and activate a high-calibre network of founders, investors, corporates, and experts that can materially accelerate the growth of iF Momentum ventures. Secure new sponsorships, strategic partnerships and commercial opportunities, and develop scalable business models and future revenue streams for iF Momentum. Your profile What matters most to us You know what separates a promising technology from a venture-scale company and have the judgement to identify opportunities with the potential to build significant, globally competitive businesses. You bring substantial professional experience from venture capital, entrepreneurship, venture building, transaction or strategy advisory, venture building, or a fast-growing technology company – ideally with direct exposure to building, financing or scaling ambitious technology ventures. You fully understand the specific challenges of DeepTech commercialisation and can bridge the worlds of science, technology, industry and capital. You have worked closely with ambitious founders through critical stages of company building – ideally including commercial scale-up, institutional fundraising, international expansion or the creation of a new market category. You are confident working with business plans, financial models, cap tables, market and competitive analyses, due diligence materials and investor narratives. You have successfully supported startups turn commercial strategy into traction – developing customers, industry partnerships, pilots and go-to-market models that can ultimately scale beyond individual projects. You combine strategic judgement with a hands-on mindset and are comfortable challenging founders on ambition, priorities, milestones and difficult decisions. You can already bring in an established network of investors, industry partners, and senior operators and know how to activate it when it can materially accelerate a venture. You have experience leading teams, projects or portfolios and know how to create clear responsibilities, high quality standards and an effective delivery culture. You communicate clearly and credibly with founders, executives, investors, scientists and external partners in an international environment. You are fluent in English; German language skills are highly desirable. source_record.description:
Job description

Who we are 
Millions of people live with urological and gynecological conditions they nevertalk about. We are here to end that silence. Kranus Health is a digital therapeutics platform running in several countries across urology and gynecology. Our newest therapy, Kranus Mictera, treats urinary incontinence in women, a condition that affects one in three women and that almost no onetakes seriously. Our therapies are built together with leading clinicians and scientists, prescribed by doctors, and reimbursed by health insurers, whichmeans everything you ship reaches patients with a real diagnosis instead of a wellness audience. We are ~50 people, everyone here owns outcomes ratherthan tickets, and AI is a settled part of how we work, so you won't be stuck in 2022 tooling here. One platform, many therapies, 3 countries. Small team. Big impact. If you live and breathe change, you will feel at home here.

The Role
As our Product Manager in charge of our consumer-facing Digital Therapeutics, you will lead the way to transform our platform of therapies from good to first-class with taste. This is not a feature-shipping role. We want someone who thinks in user journeys, obsesses over behavior change, and can tell the difference between a product that works and one that genuinely moves patients forward.

Your responsibilities

  • Therapy ownership: You own the full patient journey end-to-end – from the moment a doctor prescribes the therapy, through onboarding and the active therapy phase, to the point where patients feel a real difference and stay. AI is part of the work and part of the product – but it's a means to an end, not the goal itself. 
  • Behavior & retention: You apply proven knowledge of habit loops, nudges, feedback systems, and engagement mechanics to drive sustainable usage. 
  • Mobile ownership: You own our therapy apps across urology and gynecology end-to-end. 
  • App Store excellence: You treat ratings, store presence, and ASO as core product levers, and actively optimize the funnel from impression to activation.


YOUR TOOLKIT

  • Mobile expertise: Hands-on product management experience with consumer mobile apps. 
  • Platform fluency: You understand the technical realities of iOS and Android and know how to work with them – not around them. 
  • Data & AI fluency: You use AI to move fast, know when it's hallucinating, and back every decision with analytics and experiments, because you own the outcome.
  •  Languages: Fluent in German and English. 
  • High agency: You naturally push topics forward, bring people along, and don't wait to be asked. 
  • Taste: You know what a great, beautiful, yet functional product needs to look like in 2026. 
  • Optional – health or behavior background: Experience building patient-centric or behavior-change products, or genuine passion for it.


OUR SUPPORT AND YOUR BENEFITS

  • Trust - We believe in the talent we hire. You will receive a permanent contract. Home office is easily possible with us.
  • Body & Mind - You get an "Urban Sports Club" membership and your own leased bicycle at your free disposal.
  • Future - We support your company pension scheme and will be happy to explain the benefits to you.
  • Impact - work with meaning? Together with you we improve the health care of patients, every day.
  • Teamwork - You are part of a highly motivated team with flat hierarchies and a lot of fun at work.


CONTACT

Sounds like your next chapter? We'd love to receive your application! If you have any questions about the role or Kranus, feel free to reach out directly to our Senior People & Recruiting Manager, Annkathrin -----

cards.announcement: A definitive shift is currently happening. Corporates across the globe are no longer just reporting on sustainability; they are actively investing in it as a core financial and strategic asset. At CEEZER, we are architecting the infrastructure for enterprise-grade Climate Performance Asset management, transforming how the world's largest companies source and manage carbon credits, Energy Attribution Certificates (EAC), and Sustainable Aviation Fuel certificates (SAFc). Our platform gives the world’s most ambitious enterprises the data-driven precision, real-time monitoring, and framework-compliant reporting required to confidently deploy capital toward high-impact Climate Performance Asset portfolios and true, measurable climate action. Tasks Your mission We are looking for a Tech Lead to join our engineering team. This role requires an ambitious technical leader who can architect scalable systems, navigate complex carbon data architectures, and drive engineering excellence. Moving beyond traditional software delivery, you will translate product vision into reliable technology, lead critical architectural decisions, and leave a lasting mark on our platform from day one. Architect and scale a seamless B2B procurement platform, delivering an intuitive, enterprise-grade user interface designed for daily engagement and complex workflows. Drive end-to-end technical strategy, design, and architecture, translating ambitious product requirements into performant, scalable features and microservices. Lead by example with hands-on technical execution, authoring high-quality, maintainable code across our TypeScript, Node.js, and Next.js stack. Cultivate engineering excellence across the team, providing high-impact mentorship, technical guidance, and rigorous code reviews to continuously elevate development standards. Safeguard platform integrity, establishing robust security, reliability, and performance standards across our applications and core cloud infrastructure. Partner closely with product, design, and cross-functional teams, evaluating trade-offs and technical permutations to engineer optimal, user-centric solutions. Requirements What you need to succeed 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of technical leadership (2+ years) guiding teams through complex, full-lifecycle product deliveries. Deep technical proficiency in TypeScript and the Node.js ecosystem, alongside extensive hands-on experience building modern, data-dense interfaces with React or Next.js. Strong architectural expertise in RESTful API design, backend systems architecture, and relational data modelling (PostgreSQL experience preferred). Demonstrated commitment to engineering rigour, with a deep understanding of software design patterns, enterprise web security standards, and modern development workflows (Git, feature branching). Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure and continuous deployment, including hands-on experience building and maintaining services on platforms like AWS. Exceptional collaborative and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical decisions, bridge alignment across product teams, and mentor engineers. Basic familiarity with Python is a plus, or a strong technical curiosity to expand into auxiliary parts of our data processing stack. Benefits What's in it for you at CEEZER? A mission that matters: Work alongside international teams combining finance, tech, and climate science professionals to direct capital toward the world's most critical climate assets. Accelerated growth: We are scaling fast, and your career will too. Take opportunities to lead cross-functional initiatives and expand your strategic influence. True ownership: We are building in a brand-new market, meaning many of our best practices don’t exist yet. If you see a better workflow, tool, or strategy, you have the autonomy and backing to build it. An empowering environment: We bring together diverse global perspectives, knowing that solving complex climate challenges requires a wide mix of backgrounds and expertise. Real enterprise impact: Transform how global corporates approach sustainability. CEEZER hosts 50Mt+ of vetted carbon credits across all pathways, all backed by sophisticated data and institutional-grade risk management. A net-zero career: We practice what we preach. From your first day, we fully offset your personal and professional carbon footprint because sustainability is how we operate. The hiring process An intro call with the People Team A Technical Interview with our SVP of Tech, Felipe A Case Study with 2 Engineers from the team Create an impact with us? We know that great talent doesn’t always follow a linear path. If your experience doesn't check every single box on this list, but you have the drive and unique strengths to excel here, we still want to hear from you. Here, building a diverse team isn't a checkbox—It’s how we solve complex global challenges. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, skills, and potential, while actively working to keep unconscious bias out of our process. We’ve created an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered to succeed. We welcome diverse applicants and are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for everyone to thrive. At CEEZER, we are architecting the infrastructure for enterprise-grade Climate Performance Asset management, transforming how the world's largest companies source and manage carbon credits, Energy Attribution Certificates (EAC), and Sustainable Aviation Fuel certificates (SAFc).

Our platform gives the world’s most ambitious enterprises the data-driven precision, real-time monitoring, and framework-compliant reporting required to confidently deploy capital toward high-impact Climate Performance Asset portfolios and true, measurable climate action.

Tasks

Your mission

We are looking for a Tech Lead to join our engineering team. This role requires an ambitious technical leader who can architect scalable systems, navigate complex carbon data architectures, and drive engineering excellence. Moving beyond traditional software delivery, you will translate product vision into reliable technology, lead critical architectural decisions, and leave a lasting mark on our platform from day one.

  • Architect and scale a seamless B2B procurement platform, delivering an intuitive, enterprise-grade user interface designed for daily engagement and complex workflows.
  • Drive end-to-end technical strategy, design, and architecture, translating ambitious product requirements into performant, scalable features and microservices.
  • Lead by example with hands-on technical execution, authoring high-quality, maintainable code across our TypeScript, Node.js, and Next.js stack.
  • Cultivate engineering excellence across the team, providing high-impact mentorship, technical guidance, and rigorous code reviews to continuously elevate development standards.
  • Safeguard platform integrity, establishing robust security, reliability, and performance standards across our applications and core cloud infrastructure.
  • Partner closely with product, design, and cross-functional teams, evaluating trade-offs and technical permutations to engineer optimal, user-centric solutions.

Requirements

What you need to succeed

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of technical leadership (2+ years) guiding teams through complex, full-lifecycle product deliveries.
  • Deep technical proficiency in TypeScript and the Node.js ecosystem, alongside extensive hands-on experience building modern, data-dense interfaces with React or Next.js.
  • Strong architectural expertise in RESTful API design, backend systems architecture, and relational data modelling (PostgreSQL experience preferred).
  • Demonstrated commitment to engineering rigour, with a deep understanding of software design patterns, enterprise web security standards, and modern development workflows (Git, feature branching).
  • Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure and continuous deployment, including hands-on experience building and maintaining services on platforms like AWS.
  • Exceptional collaborative and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical decisions, bridge alignment across product teams, and mentor engineers.
  • Basic familiarity with Python is a plus, or a strong technical curiosity to expand into auxiliary parts of our data processing stack.

Benefits

What's in it for you at CEEZER?

  • A mission that matters: Work alongside international teams combining finance, tech, and climate science professionals to direct capital toward the world's most critical climate assets.
  • Accelerated growth: We are scaling fast, and your career will too. Take opportunities to lead cross-functional initiatives and expand your strategic influence.
  • True ownership: We are building in a brand-new market, meaning many of our best practices don’t exist yet. If you see a better workflow, tool, or strategy, you have the autonomy and backing to build it.
  • An empowering environment: We bring together diverse global perspectives, knowing that solving complex climate challenges requires a wide mix of backgrounds and expertise.
  • Real enterprise impact: Transform how global corporates approach sustainability. CEEZER hosts 50Mt+ of vetted carbon credits across all pathways, all backed by sophisticated data and institutional-grade risk management.
  • A net-zero career: We practice what we preach. From your first day, we fully offset your personal and professional carbon footprint because sustainability is how we operate.

The hiring process

  • An intro call with the People Team
  • A Technical Interview with our SVP of Tech, Felipe
  • A Case Study with 2 Engineers from the team

Create an impact with us?

We know that great talent doesn’t always follow a linear path. If your experience doesn't check every single box on this list, but you have the drive and unique strengths to excel here, we still want to hear from you.

Here, building a diverse team isn't a checkbox—It’s how we solve complex global challenges. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, skills, and potential, while actively working to keep unconscious bias out of our process. We’ve created an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered to succeed. We welcome diverse applicants and are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for everyone to thrive.

If you need any adjustments or specific accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. We are here to support you.
